0022600136.text: The Raptors (2-1) are hosting the Orlando Magic (1-2) in their fourth game of the 2026-27 season, sitting 2nd in the Atlantic and 4th in the East after a loss in their most recent game. Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (heel, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot, fracture) and listed Kawhi Leonard as day-to-day with knee inflammation, a game-time decision. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Paolo Banchero (ankle, sprain), while Jalen Suggs is day-to-day with a knee issue and also a game-time decision; the teams have not met yet this season, and the Raptors won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 139-87 win in Toronto on March 29.
